paragraphs.text: Read Isa 1:15.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: All men wink at the injuries and oppressions and none go about to remedy them.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: According to their wicked devices, they hurt their neighbours.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Whatever comes from them is poison, and brings death.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: They are profitable to no purpose.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is, God's vengeance to punish our enemies.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: God's protection to defend us.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: We are altogether destitute of counsel, and can find no end to our miseries.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: We express our sorrows by outward signs, some more and some less.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: This confession is general to the Church to obtain remission of sins, and the prophets did not exempt themselves from the same.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: That is, against our neighbours.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: There is neither justice nor uprightness among men.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: The wicked will destroy him.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: Meaning, to do justice, and to remedy the things that were so far out of order.
paragraphs.label: o

paragraphs.text: That is, his Church or his arm helped itself and did not seek aid from any other.
paragraphs.label: p

paragraphs.text: Signifying that God has all means at hand to deliver his Church and to punish their enemies.
